instruction: Reply just to Alex on the migration timeline email: thanks, we'll confirm the cutover date by Friday.
final_text:
I replied only to Alex (alex@brightline.example) in the "Migration timeline" thread. The email said:

"Hi Alex, Thanks. We'll confirm the cutover date by Friday. Best, Sam"

Alex's email starts "Hi all," so other people may be on the thread too. None of them got your reply. For reference, Alex proposed doing a dry run on Oct 8 and switching over to the new Brightline workspace on Oct 15.
